assumptions.rationale: Checked counterfactual limitations: freezing future teacher q/A/B is indispensable; shared future inputs alone do not freeze coefficients of a state-dependent network. Actual learned updates at every step change their own future law, so the one-edit theorem does not prove a deployment-wide bound. Conditional-mean regression is exact at a fixed reference; detached targets, reference refresh and CE-coupled encoder/predictor optimization are explicitly different or moving surrogates. Oblique I-gamma*u*k^T can be nonnormal even though its nontrivial eigenvalue is1-gamma, and the card correctly denies contraction. Directions erased by future transport are cheap under this metric, so low disturbance can mean forgetting the new correction or preserving old mistakes. No semantic revision/retention theorem is asserted.
